[EN] Malagash Must Die

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take your closest friends. Nah, take your heaviest-armed friends!

[EN] They'll think twice about fighting without their warlord.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find and slay the naga warlord Malagash.
[ES] Encuentra y asesina al señor de la guerra naga Malagash.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Ecryl at the Beachhead.
[ES] Preséntate ante Ecryl en Beachhead.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
